import_provenance.original_title: Dual pseudorandom functions from arbitrary one-way functions
import_provenance.original_statement: Does the existence of any one-way function imply a dual pseudorandom function—one remaining pseudorandom when the roles of its key and input are interchanged? Bellare–Lysyanskaya obtained constructions from one-way permutations or collision-resistant hashing, leaving the minimal-assumption question open.
